title: Physics-based Approximation and Prediction of Speedlines in Compressor Performance Maps
summary: Speedlines in compressor performance maps (CPMs) are critical for understanding and predicting compressor behavior under various operating conditions. We investigate a physics-based method for reconstructing compressor performance maps from sparse measurements by fitting each speedline with a superellipse and encoding it as a compact, interpretable vector (surge, choke, curvature, and shape parameters).
